newsitem.title: USA: Great Lakes unit buys Alliance Packaging.
newsitem.headline: Great Lakes unit buys Alliance Packaging.

text.p: Great Lakes Chemical Corp said Friday its wholly owned Bio-Lab Inc subsidiary purchased certain assets and inventory of Alliance Packaging, a Dallas-based chemical affiliate of SCP Pool Corp of Covington, La. Terms were not disclosed.

The Alliance purchase concludes a two-part transaction between BioLab and SCP. The first half of the negotiated agreement, completled in September, involved the sale of BLN, BioLab's wholesale distribution business to SCP.
Decatur, Ga.-based BioLab is a formulator and packager of chemicals for swimming pools and spas.
